model_annotations.Bulgarian: The plot illustrates the mean absolute value of the hidden state over layers in a neural network, comparing three different conditions. The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 20, with tick intervals of 1. The y-axis, labeled “Abs Mean,” also uses a linear scale, ranging from approximately 0 to 4, with tick intervals of 0.5. A dashed blue line represents the mean absolute value of the hidden state before a gate, starting at approximately 0.71 and decreasing to approximately 0.65. A dotted black line represents the mean absolute value of the hidden state after a gate, starting at approximately 0.05 and remaining relatively constant at approximately 0.04. A solid green line represents the mean absolute value of the baseline hidden state, starting at approximately 0.04 and remaining relatively constant at approximately 0.04.
